question: Fa Xian began his journey back from _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengal**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fa Xian** was a **Chinese Buddhist monk** who traveled to India to study **Buddhism** and collect **Buddhist texts.**
 
• Fa-Hien's book **Fo-kwo-ki **contains writings about India.
 
• He spoke of the **Mahayana and Hinayana** monasteries in Pataliputra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fa Xian** traveled to India during the reign of **Emperor Chandragupta II** (375-415 CE).
 
• He spent several years in India, visiting important **Buddhist sites **and studying Buddhist texts.
 
• Fa Xian's journey to India is considered one of the earliest and most important accounts of **Buddhist pilgrimage **to India.
 
• Patliputra (present-day Patna) was an important city in ancient India and was known for its** rich culture and learning.**
 
• It was the **capital** of the **Mauryan Empire **and later the Gupta Empire.
